scope_label: Plan submission, assessment, decision and amendment (Commission and Member State)
pattern_rule: Sequential procedural dependency: the output of one qualified relation is the legally stated precondition or object of the next (submission, assessment, decision, amendment or resubmission), each link made by explicit cross-reference.
governance_question: Who prepares, assesses and decides the content and financial envelope of each Member State's Social Climate Plan, and how may a decided Plan be modified?
organizing_mechanism: Explicit cross-references among provisions: A17.P1 decides 'on the basis of the assessment carried out in accordance with Article 16'; A18.P2 and A18.P3 refer to Articles 16 and 17(1); A17.P4 and A18.P1 refer back to submission under Article 4(1); A5.P3 refers to Article 16(3). The Commission is the single named assessor and decision-taker and the Member State the single named submitter within the S.
warrant_basis: The relations satisfy the sequential-dependency pattern through legally stated cross-references (decision relations are defined on the basis of the preceding assessment relation), not through chapter membership, shared actors or vocabulary.
boundary_statement: Stops at the Commission decision (A17), amendment and resubmission (A17.P4, A18). Commitment and payment lie in SC-03; control relations in SC-04; transfers in SC-07. The content of other plans and instruments referred to in the Plan provisions is outside W.
competing_grouping: Rival grouping: three separate S (preparation and consultation; assessment; amendment), rejected because A17.P1 and A18.P2-P3 explicitly bind the relations; or one S together with SC-03 (a single financing chain), considered at the architecture level (ARCH-01).

scope_label: Public consultation on the Plan (Member State, stakeholder categories, Commission)
pattern_rule: Participation followed by verification: a participation relation (A5.P1) is followed by Commission verification that the participation took place (A5.P3, by reference to paragraph 1).
governance_question: Who must be consulted before a Plan is submitted, and who verifies that the consultation took place?
organizing_mechanism: A5.P3 refers to 'paragraph 1 of this Article' (consultation) and to Article 16(3); the summary of the consultation is part of the Plan (A5.P2).
warrant_basis: Two relations coupled by an explicit cross-reference and a Plan content duty referring to the same consultation; not a grouping by theme alone.
boundary_statement: Only the consultation step; the content of consultation requirements (Article 10 of Regulation (EU) 2018/1999) and national law are outside W.
competing_grouping: Rival grouping: treat the consultation only as a condition of the submission relation (QR for A4.P1/A5.P1) rather than as an S.

scope_label: Agreement, performance-conditioned payment and enforcement (Commission and Member State)
pattern_rule: Conditional sequence with enforcement branches: the Article 17 decision conditions the Article 19 agreement; milestones and targets set in the decision condition payments (A20.P1-P3); failure triggers suspension, reduction or termination (A20.P4-P7).
governance_question: How are Fund resources committed to a Member State and released, withheld or withdrawn against performance?
organizing_mechanism: A19.P1 ('after the Commission has adopted a positive decision as referred to in Article 17'); A20.P1 ('milestones and targets indicated in the Plan, as approved in accordance with Article 17'); A20.P2 ('set out in the Commission decision referred to in Article 17'); A17.P2(b) (allocation 'to be paid in instalments, in accordance with Article 20'); A7.P2 (payment conditional on milestones and targets); A20.P4, P6, P7 refer to the preceding steps.
warrant_basis: The relations are coupled by explicit legal conditions (each step defined by reference to the preceding decision or assessment), not by the shared actors Commission and Member State.
boundary_statement: Commission-Member State financing relations of A7, A10, A12, A14, A17(2)-(3), A19, A20 and Annexes I-II; the source of the revenue (Directive 2003/87/EC) and the Financial Regulation rules are outside W.
competing_grouping: Rival grouping: one S with SC-01 (a single financing chain) or a split at the Article 17 decision; considered at the architecture level.

scope_label: Protection of financial interests and internal control (Member State, Commission, Union control bodies)
pattern_rule: Layered assurance chain: designation of national implementing, signing and audit positions (Annex III); management declaration and audit summary accompanying payment requests (A21.P2(c)); authorisation and access of Union control bodies (A21.P2(e), Annex III item 6); Commission reduction and recovery (A21.P4).
governance_question: How are the financial interests of the Union protected in the use of Fund resources, and who may check and sanction?
organizing_mechanism: A21.P1 requires an internal control system 'as further set out in Annex III'; A21.P2 states that 'the agreements referred to in Article 19 shall provide for' the obligations; A21.P2(c) refers to the payment request (A20.P1); A21.P4 refers to the agreements and to the reduction of support; A17.P3(c) links weaknesses in internal control systems to the first payment.
warrant_basis: Relations are coupled by explicit cross-references to the Annex III requirements, to the Article 19 agreements and to the payment request, and by a common object (the payment request and the agreements), not by the shared Member State actor alone.
boundary_statement: National control arrangements and Union audit and recovery relations stated in A21 and Annex III; the content of the audit and control rights (Financial Regulation Art. 129(1)), the EPPO and the discharge procedure are outside W.
competing_grouping: Rival grouping: a national internal-control S (Annex III designations) separate from a Union protection S (A21.P2(e), A21.P4).

scope_label: Monitoring, reporting and evaluation (Member State, Commission, Union institutions)
pattern_rule: Information-return chain: Member State implementation report with Annex IV indicators (A24.P1); Commission monitoring and use of the same indicators (A24.P2, A24.P4); Commission evaluation reports that take Member State reports into account (A27.P1) addressed to four Union bodies.
governance_question: How is implementation of the Fund monitored and evaluated and to whom is the information returned?
organizing_mechanism: A27.P1 evaluates 'taking into account the results of the first reports submitted by Member States in accordance with Article 24'; A24.P1 and A24.P4 both rely on the Annex IV indicators; A6.P1(m) and A17.P2(d)-(e) require the Plan and decision to contain monitoring arrangements and indicators.
warrant_basis: Three relations coupled by an explicit cross-reference (A27.P1 to Article 24) and a common indicator set (Annex IV), not by a shared actor alone.
boundary_statement: Information flows only; no assessment or sanction capacity of the recipients is stated in W (see closure). Recipients other than the Commission are not given a follow-up competence.
competing_grouping: Rival grouping: monitoring as a stage inside SC-03 (milestone verification); rejected as a separate S because A24 reports are not linked to the A20 payment assessment (closure CL monitor link).

scope_label: Social climate dialogue with the European Parliament (Commission and competent committees)
pattern_rule: Invitation followed by response: the competent committees invite the Commission to discuss (A26.P1); the Commission takes account of the views expressed through that dialogue (A26.P2).
governance_question: Through which channel can the European Parliament question the Commission on the Fund, and what must the Commission do with the views expressed?
organizing_mechanism: A26.P2 refers to 'the views expressed through the social climate dialogue' (A26.P1).
warrant_basis: Two relations coupled by explicit cross-reference plus one derived accountability object; the A25 provisions are not included because no provision couples them to the dialogue (thematic proximity only).
boundary_statement: The dialogue relations of A26 only; transmission (A25.P1) and the invitation to provide information (A25.P3) remain ungrouped relations.
competing_grouping: Rival grouping: include A25.P1 and A25.P3 with A26 as one parliamentary-information S; rejected for want of a stated legal coupling.

scope_label: Transfers between the Fund and shared-management programmes (Member State, Commission)
pattern_rule: Request-assessment-implementation: Member States request transfers (A11.P1, A11.P2); the Commission assesses requested transfers (A16.P2); transferred resources are implemented directly or through programme amendments (A11.P1, A28 Article 26a).
governance_question: How can resources move into and out of the Fund and who assesses the transfer?
organizing_mechanism: A16.P2 refers to 'transfers requested in accordance with Article 11'; A11.P2 refers to Plans submitted under Article 4(1) and to Article 26a of Regulation (EU) 2021/1060, inserted by Article 28.
warrant_basis: Relations coupled by explicit cross-references between Articles 11, 16(2) and 28; external instrument content is not used.
boundary_statement: Relations stated in W only; the rules of the receiving funds and Regulation (EU) 2021/1060 are outside W (stop at the highest level supported by W).
competing_grouping: Rival grouping: the transfer relations as part of SC-01 (Plan content, since transfers are requested in Plans).
